description: Resume a batch whose remaining items were paused with status paused_low_success because one domain or detector class kept failing (the machine-readable paused_reason says which). Use after the batch status shows paused items and you want them retried; items that failed were not charged. Returns batch_id, resumed (items re-enqueued) and status. Errors: nothing_to_resume, resume_in_progress, insufficient_credits.
name: alterlab_batch_resume
title: Resume Paused Batch
